sloka: अभिवाद्य मुनेः पादौ मुनिपुत्रा महर्षये ।सर्वं निवेदयामासुस्तस्यास्तु रुदितस्वनम् ।। ७.४९.२ ॥
transliteration: abhivādya muneḥ pādau muniputrā maharṣaye ।sarvaṁ nivedayāmāsustasyāstu ruditasvanam ।। 7.49.2 ॥

translations.english: Having saluted the feet of the great sage, the hermit boys reported to him everything about her crying.
